races.description:
Carrying the blood of a celestial, an Aasimar is usually good-aligned and fights
against evil in the world.
races.name: Aasimar

races.description:
Aasimar Scourge are imbued with a divine energy that blazes intensely within them.
It feeds a powerful desire to destroy evil-a desire that is, at its best,
unflinching and, at its worst, all-consuming.

Starts with 1 level of: Ranger
races.name: Aasimar Scourge

races.description:
You were built for war. With a greatsword in hand, you mercilessly smite your
foes and leave behind only a wake of destruction.
races.name: Bladeforged
